title: Critiquing an Argument
description: Use principled argument critique to synthesize and reformulate ideas related to critiquing an argument with appropriate C2 complexity.
objectives: Use principled argument critique to synthesize and reformulate ideas related to critiquing an argument with appropriate C2 complexity.

stages.title: Understand meaning and form
stages.instructions: Read the concept, pattern, examples, contrast, common issue, and recap.

blocks.text: The communicative aim of this lesson is to use principled argument critique to synthesize and reformulate ideas related to critiquing an argument with appropriate C2 complexity. The central language focus is principled argument critique. In the context of advanced academic & intellectual discussion, form and meaning work together: first identify the relationship between the ideas, then choose wording that makes that relationship clear to another person. At C2 content level, control comes from flexible choices rather than rare vocabulary. Preserve subtle meaning while reframing, compressing, expanding, or shifting register, and make rhetorical effects deliberate rather than decorative.

blocks.explanation: This model establishes the main communicative move.

blocks.explanation: This model develops or qualifies the message.

blocks.text: Start with the model “The discussion highlighted apparent contradiction.” It establishes a useful direction for the exchange. The second model, “A clear explanation addresses internal coherence directly.” adds another layer: a reason, implication, contrast, or response. Notice how each complete chunk does a communicative job. Practice replacing one detail while preserving the original grammar, stance, and register. Then connect the revised sentence to a relevant consequence or example instead of changing topic abruptly.

A useful pattern for this lesson is: principled argument critique. Use it when the situation genuinely calls for that meaning. Contrast matters: a direct factual statement presents information, while a qualified or hypothetical form changes the speaker's commitment to it. The choice should be driven by evidence, time reference, relationship, and purpose. In listening, pay attention not only to individual words but also to linkers, stress, and the speaker's degree of certainty.

blocks.title: Contrast
blocks.text: Compare a direct statement with language shaped by principled argument critique; the intended meaning determines the form.

A common issue is to select an advanced-looking form without maintaining its meaning across the sentence. That can create a mismatch in time, stance, or register. Check three things: what happened or is being proposed, how certain the speaker is, and what response is expected. For critiquing an argument, clarity comes from a coherent message rather than maximum complexity. The later stages recycle the same vocabulary and expressions so that recognition becomes controlled production and then flexible interaction.

blocks.title: Common issue
blocks.text: Do not add complexity that changes the time reference, degree of certainty, or relationship with the listener.

stages.instructions: Listen first, then reveal the text and notice connections, register, and emphasis.

segments.text: To begin with, The discussion highlighted apparent contradiction. A clear explanation addresses internal coherence directly.
In this situation, A clear explanation addresses internal coherence directly. The speaker emphasized explanatory power.
From another perspective, The speaker emphasized explanatory power. Our response should account for analytical weakness.
More specifically, Our response should account for analytical weakness. This example illustrates methodological fit clearly.
Even so, This example illustrates methodological fit clearly. We should consider quality of evidence carefully.
As a result, We should consider quality of evidence carefully. The discussion highlighted epistemic limit.
On reflection, The discussion highlighted epistemic limit. A clear explanation addresses withhold judgment directly.
Ultimately, A clear explanation addresses withhold judgment directly. The discussion highlighted apparent contradiction.
